verdict.rationale:
Riveter explicitly supports scheduling any project to monitor for changes and keep data fresh, with refresh intervals as frequent as every minute, and webhook_url delivers run.completed/run.finished notifications so a data-engineer is alerted as changes are detected. This directly matches the story of monitoring pages for price/listing updates and being notified.

missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the monitoring+webhook pipeline working end-to-end, and explicit change-diffing/alerting semantics (vs. just run-completion notification).
